0022600113.text: The Pacers are 1-1 and sit 3rd in the Central, 0.5 games back and 9th in the East, after a loss in their most recent game, while the 0-1 Nets are 4th in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back and 10th in the East. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder). Indiana won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 123-94 road win in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026, and no games have been played between the teams so far in 2026-27.
